Per-domain rate limiting applies delay between requests to same domain

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"max_concurrent\":1,\"max_depth\":1}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.crawl_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(length(result.pages))
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.pages, 0).status_code)
```
